name: regex_test
description: Run a Python regular expression over a text and list every match with its groups, named groups and spans, plus an optional substitution preview and split, under a hard time limit. Flags IGNORECASE, MULTILINE, DOTALL, VERBOSE and ASCII; search, match or fullmatch anchoring. A pattern that backtracks catastrophically is stopped by a timer and reported as a timeout instead of hanging; invalid patterns report the error position.

anchor.description: search: every match anywhere; match: at the start; fullmatch: the whole text

replacement.description: re.sub template (\1, \g<name>) for a substitution preview

split.description: Also split the text on the pattern

timeout.description: Seconds before the run is stopped

catalog.source: Python standard library re module (behaviour and documentation examples); timeout through signal.setitimer
